title: CRYSTAL ZIPPER
description: A continuous faceted material stores the direction and strength of your drag as stress. Cracks keep propagating after release, redistribute stress and later heal; toughness, propagation, diffusion, shear and healing move the same gesture from ductile glowing strain to brittle zipper-like cascades.

visual_finish.composition: an edge-to-edge field of offset triangular facets reads as one material while drag-written stress produces branching warm fracture zippers
visual_finish.material_model: smoky dark crystal facets with restrained bronze stress and narrow hot fracture seams, without a decorative square background
detail_scales: individual relief facets and narrow crack seams
